outcome: Maternal and fetal composite adverse outcome
cohort: Women who had an attempt of labor in a single medical center between January 2006 and December 2017
finding: Neither nurses' shift change nor on-call physicians' shift change was associated with an increase in adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that nurses' shift changes and on-call physicians' shift changes were not associated with an increase in cesarean delivery rates.
